title: Ulyana and the Postcard
author: Wendell Kavanagh
blurb: Mara Brightwater, a pastry chef whose café is three missed payments from gone, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. But when the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must forgive the person in the mirror first, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
